title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting transcripts for apps and agents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, transcript-access controls and consumption licensing are supported by Microsoft's documentation. The documented default, effective date and organiser-tenant rules match the briefing.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: General availability is targeted for November CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap gives September CY2026 as the preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "September CY2026"

claims.claim: The listed release phases are General Availability and Preview.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Web as the platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap products are Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) and Work IQ.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Teams", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)", "Work IQ"]

claims.claim: The roadmap describes real-time access to Teams meeting transcripts for assistance and insights.
claims.quote: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

claims.claim: Work IQ lets apps and agents, including organisation-built ones, receive a Teams meeting or call transcript while it is in progress.
claims.quote: Work IQ lets agents and apps, including ones your organization builds, receive the transcript of a Teams meeting or call while it's in progress.

claims.claim: A separate Work IQ access setting controls access to real-time transcripts.
claims.quote: The Work IQ access setting controls whether they can. It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.claim: Work IQ access is independent of Microsoft Graph access.
claims.quote: It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; controls[0].note; What's changing
claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default and requires an administrator to enable it, supporting admin-opt-in.
claims.quote:
It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.
In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Enabling Work IQ access does not start transcription.
claims.quote: Transcription is running. Work IQ doesn't start transcription.

claims.claim: AI must be allowed in the meeting, including Allow AI in all meetings being on, for real-time transcripts to flow.
claims.quote:
| Allow AI in all meetings | Work IQ access | Result |
| Off | Off or On | No transcript is available. |
| On | Off | Work IQ requests are denied. Other AI experiences work as configured. |
| On | On | Agents and apps can receive the real-time transcript. |

claims.claim: Transcription must be running for an app to receive a real-time transcript.
claims.quote:
An app receives a real-time transcript only when these conditions are also met:
Transcription is running. Work IQ doesn't start transcription.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user.
claims.quote: The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user and has the permissions it needs in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: An app needs the appropriate Microsoft Entra permissions to receive transcripts.
claims.quote: The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user and has the permissions it needs in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Work IQ must be enabled for the signed-in user's organisation.
claims.quote: Work IQ is enabled for that user's organization.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn says Work IQ access takes effect on 14 November 2026.
claims.quote: Work IQ access takes effect on November 14, 2026.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Real-time transcripts delivered through Work IQ include speaker names.
claims.quote: Real-time transcripts that apps receive through Work IQ include speaker names.

claims.claim: Include speaker attribution applies only to Microsoft Graph.
claims.quote: The Include speaker attribution setting applies only to Microsoft Graph.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The meeting organiser's organisation determines the Work IQ access setting used, not the app's tenant.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses the setting of the organization that organized the meeting, not the setting of the app's organization or of the user the app acts for.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Apps already receiving real-time transcripts through Work IQ need the setting enabled to keep working.
claims.quote: If apps in your organization already receive real-time transcripts through Work IQ, turn on Work IQ access before that date to keep them working.

claims.claim: Turning off Work IQ access does not stop transcripts apps are already receiving.
claims.quote: Turning off Work IQ access doesn't stop transcripts that apps are already receiving. They continue until the meeting or call ends. New requests are denied.

claims.claim: Setting changes are not immediate.
claims.quote: Changes aren't immediate. It can take some time before a change applies to new requests.

claims.claim: The Work IQ access setting does not affect Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams.
claims.quote: Microsoft AI experiences in Teams, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Facilitator, and intelligent recap, keep working as configured.

claims.claim: The Work IQ access setting does not affect Facilitator.
claims.quote: Microsoft AI experiences in Teams, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Facilitator, and intelligent recap, keep working as configured.

claims.claim: The Work IQ access setting does not affect intelligent recap.
claims.quote: Microsoft AI experiences in Teams, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Facilitator, and intelligent recap, keep working as configured.

claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost

claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ real-time transcripts licence license pricing rate. claims.claim: No separate transcript-specific rate is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ real-time transcripts licence license pricing rate. Opened meeting-transcript-api-access, agents-experience/add-work-iq, work-iq/enable-work-iq and usage-based-billing-overview-copilot-credits on Learn; found no transcript-specific rate.

claims.claim: Learn states a separate spending policy is not required for Work IQ.
claims.quote: A separate spending policy isn't required for Work IQ.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Enabling Work IQ requires a usage-based billing plan set up in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: A usage-based billing plan set up in Copilot Studio with an Azure subscription and resource group assigned.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The user must be assigned to the Work IQ billing plan.
claims.quote: The user assigned to the billing plan

claims.claim: Agents using Work IQ may consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses the Microsoft Copilot harness and Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Work IQ access is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -Identity Global -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true enables Work IQ transcript access.
claims.quote:
When set to true, agents and apps can access real-time transcripts through Work IQ.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: The Work IQ transcript access parameter requires the latest Teams PowerShell module.
claims.quote: This parameter requires the latest version of the Teams PowerShell module.

claims.claim: For a tenant-registered app, its API permissions are at Microsoft Entra admin center > Entra ID > App registrations > app > API permissions.
claims.quote:
Browse to Entra ID > App registrations, and then select your client application (not your web API).
Select API permissions, then Add a permission and select My APIs in the sidebar.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants with clientId, consentType AllPrincipals, resourceId and scope grants tenant-wide delegated consent.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants
Request body
{
"clientId": "00001111-aaaa-2222-bbbb-3333cccc4444",
"consentType": "AllPrincipals",
"resourceId": "a0a0a0a0-bbbb-cccc-dddd-e1e1e1e1e1e1",
"scope": "User.Read.All Group.Read.All"
}

claims.claim: Permissions granted programmatically are not subject to review or confirmation.
claims.quote: Permissions granted programmatically are not subject to review or confirmation.

claims.claim: Permissions granted programmatically take effect immediately.
claims.quote: Permissions granted programmatically are not subject to review or confirmation. They take effect immediately.

claims.claim: The meeting policy's Recording & transcription section is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowTranscription $true allows transcription for users with the policy.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity SalesMeetingPolicy -AllowTranscription $True
This policy will use all the existing values except one: AllowTranscription; in this example, meetings for users with this policy can include real time or post meeting captions and transcriptions.

claims.claim: The Work IQ transcript toggle is tenant-wide, with no per-group scoping on that configuration.
claims.quote:
Use this cmdlet to set the configuration for your organization.
-EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess
Determines whether WorkIQ can access real-time transcript data in the tenant.
-Identity
The only valid input is Global

claims.claim: Existing enterprise apps have a consent route at Entra ID > Enterprise apps > All applications > app > Security > Permissions.
claims.quote:
Browse to Entra ID > Enterprise apps > All applications.
Enter the name of the existing application in the search box, and then select the application from the search results.
Select Permissions under Security.

claims.claim: The consent call must use the app's required resource and delegated scopes; the cited sample scopes are Microsoft Graph examples rather than Work IQ permissions.
claims.quote:
The permissions are defined by a resource API and granted to your enterprise application, which is the client application.
The Microsoft Graph API defines the delegated permissions, User.Read.All and Group.Read.All.

claims.claim: The variable cost rating reflects metered Work IQ consumption using Copilot Credits.
claims.quote:
Work IQ uses consumption billing.
Work IQ uses the Microsoft Copilot harness and Copilot Credits.
